# Eclipse SWT

The Linux edition of Hoshira uses Eclipse SWT to embed the operating system's
WebKitGTK browser.

- Project: https://www.eclipse.org/swt/
- Artifact: `org.eclipse.platform:org.eclipse.swt.gtk.linux.x86_64`
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0
- License text: https://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-2.0/

Eclipse SWT is a third-party component and is not covered by Hoshira's
proprietary license.
